description: This file is an HTML webpage implementing a database visualizer interface, including styling and embedded JavaScript for dynamic content loading, interaction, and data visualization.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and updates the UI sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, updates UI, and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database item and loads its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a given database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a specified table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs an HTML table from the data array and inserts into the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings for expand/collapse.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
